title: JobBored API error envelope (api-error.v1)
description: The error body every JobBored HTTP route returns: the local API (server/index.mjs, :3847) and the discovery worker (:8644). Worker bodies also keep their legacy `ok: false` and `message` fields, and route-specific fields such as `reason`, `auth` or `remediation`; readers must ignore fields they do not know. `/ingest-url` extraction outcomes carry this envelope with HTTP 200 and `code` equal to `reason`.

error.description: One human-readable sentence saying what went wrong. Safe to show the user.

code.description: Stable machine code for the failure. The worker and the local API both use lower_snake_case (for example `invalid_request`, `sheets_credential_missing`, `run_not_found`, `invalid_json`, `payload_too_large`, `not_found`).

detail.description: Optional technical detail (a parser message, an upstream status). Never contains secrets.

nextStep.description: Optional instruction for the user or the calling agent to recover.

retryable.description: True when repeating the same request later may succeed without any change (timeouts, 5xx, rate limits).

ok.description: Legacy worker field; always false on an error body.

message.description: Legacy worker field; equals or paraphrases `error`.
